as.sfi_deduplication_instructions: Deduplicate Senegal Math SFI candidates conservatively. This bilingual Wolof/French curriculum has no stable item-level statement codes: do not use table numbers, section numbers, week numbers, CE1/CE2 labels, palier/jéego numbers, or numeric Objectif d'apprentissage values as merge identities. Treat those values only as source context, sequencing, or provenance. Use same statement_type plus equivalent normalized description/source_text as review evidence, not as an automatic merge rule. Merge candidates only when they clearly represent the same source-visible curriculum item and their source context is compatible: same canonical statement_type, equivalent Wolof/French or mixed-language statement text, and matching or overlapping provenance such as the same source segment, same or adjacent extraction-window overlap, same table local_code, same table row/header indexes, same activity domain, same CE level, same palier/jéego context, and same week/row sequence where relevant. Merge obvious row-overlap, repeated filldown, or continued-table artifacts that repeat the same competence, palier competency, weekly objective, or Objectif spécifique in the same local context. Treat Wolof and French paired text in the same cell, adjacent paired source statements, or one mixed-language candidate as one logical item when they express the same competency or objective. Do not keep separate solely because one candidate is Wolof, French, or mixed-language if the source role and local context match. Keep candidates separate when repeated labels or similar no-code text occur under different activity domains, CE levels, paliers/jéego, weeks, table sections, or source-order neighborhoods. In particular, recurring headings such as Paliers du niveau CE1, Paliers du niveau CE2, Palier 1, Palier 2, Activités numériques, Activités géométriques, Activités de mesure, and Résolution de problèmes are weak duplicate signals and may be distinct local organizers under different contexts. Keep Objectif hebdomadaire candidates distinct when they occur in different weeks, paliers, activity columns, or planning rows unless the evidence shows they are the same source row repeated by table overlap. Keep Objectif spécifique candidates distinct when they belong to different palier/domain/table-row contexts even if the wording is similar. Mark conflict or needs_review rather than merging when candidates have materially different statement_type, source role, language pairing, row/header provenance, palier/domain context, or incompatible descriptions. Do not infer hierarchy, parentage, final IDs, or canonical final wording during dedup; This step should only decide merge, keep_separate, conflict, or needs_review for the supplied registry candidates.
as.sfi_extraction_instructions:
Extract Senegal Math StandardsFrameworkItem candidates from the bilingual Wolof/French curriculum without assuming stable official standard codes. Preserve original Wolof/French source text and language tags. Treat the framework, stage (Tolluwaay 2 / Étape 2 / CE1-CE2), activity domains (Activités numériques, Activités géométriques, Activités de mesure, Résolution de problèmes), CE levels, and paliers/jéego as grouping or sequencing context. In the competency-frame table and competency blocks, extract Compétence de cycle, Compétence de l'étape, and Compétences de base as high-level Standard or Standard Grouping candidates according to context. In planning tables, use Semaine/Palier rows to capture sequence context: extract palier/jéego expectation statements when the row contains the visible palier competency text, and extract weekly activity-cell learning objectives when they are normative learning objectives. Do not extract the labels Semaine 1, Semaine 2, Palier 1, CE1, CE2, Tableau 1, etc. as standalone SFIs or statement_code values. In detailed apprentissages ponctuels tables, treat Objectif spécifique as the main leaf Standard SFI. The Objectif d'apprentissage column in these tables is usually a local numeric ordinal such as 1, 2, or 3; do not extract those numeric values as SFIs, statement_code values, or durable merge keys. Use them only as row-order/provenance context. If an Objectif d'apprentissage cell ever contains a full normative objective instead of a numeric/local label and Objectif spécifique is empty, it may be extracted as the row's leaf Standard. Treat Contenus as descriptor/metadata/guidance attached to the objective, not as a standalone Standard unless explicitly normative. Treat Durée as metadata only. Ignore pure integration/evaluation/checkpoint rows as standards unless they contain a clear learning objective. Always retain provenance, page indices, table local_code, row order, section context, and whether the text came from raw rows, rows_grid, or rows_filldown. Extract Compétence de cycle and Compétence de l'étape when they appear as visible block/paragraph statements under Cadre de compétences / Cëslaayu manoore, not only when they appear in tables. This document has no stable item-level statement codes; do not use table numbers, section numbers, week numbers, CE level labels, palier/jéego numbers, or objective-order numbers as statement_code. Treat them as provenance, hierarchy, or sequencing context only, and set statement_code to null unless a source row contains a true official item code.

Use the runtime as_statement_type_policy as a closed set of canonical statement_type labels. Output the French source-facing canonical labels exactly as configured; do not invent activity-domain qualifiers, CE levels, palier/jéego numbers, week labels, table numbers, or language names inside statement_type. Use Étape for Tolluwaay 2 / Étape 2 / CE1-CE2 organizers; Niveau for CE1/CE2 and Paliers du niveau CE1/CE2 section organizers; Domaine d'activité for Activités numériques, Activités géométriques, Activités de mesure, and Résolution de problèmes organizers; Section de compétences only for visible headings that organize competence statements. Use Compétence de cycle, Compétence de l'étape, Compétence de base, and Compétence de palier for normative competence statements. Use Palier only for label-only palier/jéego organizer headings; use Compétence de palier, not Palier, when the source text contains a full palier/jéego competency statement. Use Objectif hebdomadaire only for normative activity-cell objectives in Semaine / Palier planning tables. In detailed Objectif d'apprentissage | Objectif spécifique | Contenus | Durée tables, use Objectif spécifique for the main leaf objective. Use Objectif d'apprentissage only when the Objectif d'apprentissage cell itself contains a full normative objective and Objectif spécifique is empty; never use it for numeric local ordinals such as 1, 2, or 3.

Additional Senegal Math extraction clarifications after artifact review:

1. Cycle and stage competency blocks: In the Cadre de compétences / Cëslaayu manoore section, extract both Wolof and French visible competency paragraphs when they appear as adjacent paired source statements. Do not drop the Wolof statement solely because a French statement with the same role appears nearby. A Wolof paragraph beginning "Ca njeextel diirub njàng mi" under MANOORE DIIRUB NJÀNG MI / COMPÉTENCE DE CYCLE is a Compétence de cycle. A Wolof paragraph beginning "Ca njeextel tolluwaay 2" under MANOORE TOLLUWAAY BI / COMPÉTENCE DE L’ÉTAPE is a Compétence de l'étape.

2. Compétence de base versus Compétence de l'étape: Reserve Compétence de l'étape only for the single global Tolluwaay 2 / Étape 2 competency statement under MANOORE TOLLUWAAY BI / COMPÉTENCE DE L’ÉTAPE. When a visible paragraph or table cell appears under Les compétences de base des activités, Tableau 1, Manoore mi lalu / Compétence de base, or an activity-domain section such as Activités numériques, Activités géométriques, Activités de mesure, or Résolution de problèmes, and it expresses a domain-level "Intégrer..." / "Boole mooñ..." competence, classify it as Compétence de base, not Compétence de l'étape.

3. Objectif hebdomadaire cells with Contenu(s): In Semaine / Palier planning tables, some weekly activity cells contain a learning objective followed by "Contenu:" or "Contenus:" descriptor text in the same cell. For Objectif hebdomadaire candidates, use only the normative objective portion before "Contenu:" / "Contenus:" as the candidate description and, where possible, as the candidate source_text. Do not include trailing Contenu(s) descriptor fragments in the candidate description unless they are necessary to make the objective intelligible. Treat Contenu(s) fragments as descriptor/metadata/evidence only, not as standalone Standards and not as durable merge-key text.

statement_type_policy.description: Visible curriculum stage organizer for the target Tolluwaay 2 / Étape 2 / CE1-CE2 scope.
Visible CE-level organizer, including Paliers du niveau CE1 and Paliers du niveau CE2 section headings.
Visible activity-domain organizer, such as Activités numériques, Activités géométriques, Activités de mesure, or Résolution de problèmes.

aliases: Compétence de cycle et compétence d'étape
statement_type_policy.description: Visible structural heading that organizes competency statements, such as Cadre de compétences / Cëslaayu manoore or the cycle/stage competence section.

Official cycle-level competence statement visible in the Senegal Math curriculum. Includes the Wolof cycle paragraph beginning 'Ca njeextel diirub njàng mi' under MANOORE DIIRUB NJÀNG MI / COMPÉTENCE DE CYCLE and the paired French paragraph beginning 'A la fin du cycle'.

Official global stage-level competence statement for Tolluwaay 2 / Étape 2 only. Use for the statements under MANOORE TOLLUWAAY BI / COMPÉTENCE DE L’ÉTAPE, including the Wolof paragraph beginning 'Ca njeextel tolluwaay 2' and its paired French paragraph. Do not use for domain-level activity competencies under Activités numériques, Activités géométriques, Activités de mesure, Résolution de problèmes, or Tableau 1; those are Compétence de base.

Official Compétence de base / Manoore mi lalu statement for an activity domain. Use for domain-level competence statements under Les compétences de base des activités, Tableau 1, Manoore mi lalu / Compétence de base, or activity-domain sections such as Activités numériques, Activités géométriques, Activités de mesure, and Résolution de problèmes. These include visible 'Intégrer...' / 'Boole mooñ...' domain competency statements and should not be classified as Compétence de l'étape.
Visible label-only palier/jéego organizer heading, such as Palier 1 — Activités numériques CE1. Use only for headings/organizers, not for full normative palier competency statements.

aliases: Palier (Compétence de palier - résolution de problèmes)
statement_type_policy.description: Visible normative palier/jéego competency statement, such as a sentence beginning Jéego 1: ... or PALIER 1: ... followed by competency text.

Normative weekly activity-cell learning objective from Semaine / Palier planning tables. Do not use for detailed apprentissages ponctuels tables. If the same planning-table cell contains a trailing 'Contenu:' or 'Contenus:' descriptor, use the objective portion before Contenu(s) as the candidate description; treat Contenu(s) as descriptor/metadata rather than part of the standard.

Full normative objective from an Objectif d'apprentissage cell only when that cell contains actual objective text and Objectif spécifique is empty. Do not use for numeric local ordinals such as 1, 2, or 3.
Main leaf Objectif spécifique from detailed apprentissages ponctuels tables.

lc.generation_instructions: Create LearningComponents from leaf normative math objectives, especially Objectif spécifique rows. Use the source language text as-is; do not translate for v0. Prefer a 1-to-1 component when the objective is already atomic. Split only when one objective clearly contains multiple distinct mathematical skills. Do not create LearningComponents from Durée, Contenus alone, numeric Objectif d'apprentissage cells, integration/checkpoint labels, or broad domain/palier groupings unless the profile later marks them as LC sources. When an Academic Standards source quote contains a learning objective followed by 'Contenu:' or 'Contenus:', treat the Contenu(s) fragment as descriptor/metadata unless a later LC profile explicitly requests content-derived components.
